environment.description: AWS Step Functions workflow triggered by API Gateway (REST API, no request validation). API Gateway passes full request body including customer_name directly into Step Functions StartExecution input. The Lambda function runs with CloudWatch Logs as the sole logging destination. No input validation or encoding is performed on customer_name before it reaches the logger. CloudWatch Logs Insights queries are used for security monitoring and alerting, and downstream SIEM ingests raw log lines for correlation.

config.api_gateway: REST API with no request validator, proxy integration to Step Functions
config.step_functions: Standard workflow, passes raw API input to Lambda task state
config.logging: CloudWatch Logs with SIEM ingestion via subscription filter
config.network: Public API endpoint, no IP restrictions
